description: Use this when the user gives a French postal address, complete or partial, and wants it checked, completed, normalized or geolocated: returns the best Base Adresse Nationale matches with house number, street, postcode, city, INSEE municipality code, coordinates and a match score, plus whether the best match is reliable. Do not use for addresses outside France, for finding who lives or works at an address, or for listing the companies at an address.

address.description: Postal address, e.g. 8 bd du Port Amiens.

postcode.description: Optional 5-digit postcode to narrow the search.

name: search_addresses
title: Normalize a French postal address
